items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Jerry Aspinel was out there for a while, but I don't know. He used to play with the Dawn Busters too.

ctx.x: Well, Jerry Aspinel was out there for a while, but I don't know. He used to play with the Dawn Busters too.
